title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: weekly and monthly trendlines for adoption and impact metrics
summary: The briefing's licensing thresholds, trendline behaviour and governance controls are supported by Microsoft documentation. It accurately reports the roadmap's older target and In development status alongside Learn's documentation of the available trendlines.

claims.quote: Users don't need a paid Viva Insights license or a Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.claim: The dashboard is available to Microsoft 365 or Office 365 business or enterprise subscription customers.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights is available to any customer with a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 subscription for business or enterprise, and who has an active Exchange Online account.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[2].governs; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The dashboard's minimum group size suppresses metrics and trendlines for groups smaller than the threshold.
claims.quote: To protect individual privacy, metrics aren't shown for groups that are smaller than the minimum group size.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[2].note; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The minimum group size defaults to 10 employees.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.claim: The minimum allowed group size is five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five, then select Save.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot filter shows insights only for employees with a Copilot license.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot filter shows insights only for employees who have a Copilot license.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The unified exclusion list can exclude individual employees from dashboard aggregates.
claims.quote: The user exclusion list allows admins to specify which employees' data should not be shown in the dashboard or other Viva Insights reports. You can exclude employees individually using a .csv file

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The exclusion list can exclude Microsoft Entra ID groups.
claims.quote: or you can exclude groups of people using Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Senior leaders in qualifying tenants can receive dashboard access automatically.
claims.quote: Users who are senior leaders within large teams as determined by their Entra ID data manager attribute can automatically view the report.

claims.claim: Automatic senior-leader access uses the Microsoft Entra ID manager hierarchy attribute.
claims.quote: Access is based on Microsoft Entra ID Data, specifically the manager hierarchy attribute.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators can add or remove individual users and groups from dashboard access.
claims.quote: You can turn access to the Viva Insights web app on or off for individual users or groups using Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: The dashboard and admin center usage reports use the same underlying data set.
claims.quote: Both the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard and the admin center usage reports leverage the same underlying data set, but they're intended for different audiences.

claims.claim: Differences in prerequisites can cause discrepancies between dashboard and admin center reports.
claims.quote: Also, differences in each report’s prerequisites and time periods might cause data discrepancies.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The dashboard and admin center reports use different time periods.
claims.quote: The Copilot Dashboard represents data over the previous 28 days. The admin center, however, uses a rolling window for its reports, for the last 7, 30, 90, or 180 days.

claims.where: Scope: Roles; controls[0].note; controls[1].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The dashboard settings page identifies the AI Administrator for web app access management.
claims.quote:
Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups

Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: The AI Administrator is listed for minimum group size management.
claims.quote:
Set minimum group size for the Copilot Dashboard and Agent Dashboard

Applies to: AI Administrator and Viva Insights Administrator

claims.where: Scope: Roles; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Viva Insights Administrator is listed for minimum group size management.
claims.quote: Applies to: AI Administrator and Viva Insights Administrator

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can manage all the documented dashboard settings.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: The Organization filter uses Microsoft Entra ID Department by default.
claims.quote: The Organization filter corresponds to the Microsoft Entra ID data source field named "Department."

claims.claim: An Insights administrator's uploaded Organization attribute replaces the default Organization source.
claims.quote: If your Insights admin uploads a .csv file with the attribute of Organization, the "Organization" data in the filter will update.

claims.claim: A Global administrator's uploaded Microsoft_Organization attribute replaces the default Organization source.
claims.quote: If your Global admin uploads a .csv file with the attribute of Microsoft_Organization, the "Organization" data in the filter will update.

claims.claim: The Insights-admin route to the Job function filter requires uploaded FunctionType attributes.
claims.quote: If your Insights admin uploads the file in the Viva Insights web app, they need to upload FunctionType attributes for you to see the Job function dropdowns.

claims.claim: The Global-admin route to the Job function filter requires uploaded Microsoft_JobDiscipline attributes.
claims.quote: If your Global admin uploads the file in the Microsoft 365 admin center, they need to upload Microsoft_JobDiscipline attributes for you to see the Job function dropdown.

claims.claim: The web app policy path is Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Viva Insights > Viva Insights web app > Access setting.
claims.quote: Select Create a policy. ... Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy. ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId "Viva Insights web app", Name DisableFeatureForAll, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone disables tenant-wide web app access.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant

ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: Turning off the Viva Insights web app control disables the entire app, including the Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: The web app feature access control supports tenant, group and user scope.
claims.quote: The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level using the Viva Insights web app feature access management control

claims.claim: The VFAM feature table names Global admin for the web app, whereas the dashboard settings page names AI Administrator.
claims.quote: |  | Viva Insights web app | No | Global admin | Viva Insights |

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Individual access is managed through Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. Search for the people you'd like to add, and select them from the list. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: No API or automation is documented for editing the dashboard's individual-user and group access list.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Dashboard manage access users groups Microsoft Graph PowerShell API minimum group size; "Copilot Dashboard" "Graph" access settings users API. Opened dashboard settings, VFAM and Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy; found policies but no operation for this access list.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator does not automatically receive dashboard access.
claims.quote: The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app. To gain access, the admin must also add themselves using the process below.

claims.claim: Adding or removing users from web app access takes effect in 24 hours.
claims.quote: When you add or remove users to the Viva Insights web app, the change will go into effect in 24 hours.

claims.claim: To grant group access, select Groups instead of Users.
claims.quote: At the top, select Groups. Search for the Entra ID groups you'd like to add, and select them from the list.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Minimum group size is managed at Settings > Microsoft Viva > Microsoft Viva Insights > Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365 > Manage minimum group size.
claims.quote: go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights. ... Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center minimum-group-size procedure is for tenants without a Viva Insights license.
claims.quote: If your tenant does not have a Viva Insights license, use these steps to set the minimum group size:

claims.claim: For tenants with a Viva Insights license, a Viva Insights Administrator sets the threshold in Viva Insights privacy settings instead.
claims.quote: Or, if your tenant has a Viva Insights license and you're a Viva Insights Administrator, use these steps to change the minimum group size.

claims.claim: No automation is documented for setting the dashboard minimum group size.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Insights" "minimum group size" "PowerShell" API; "minimumGroupSize" "insights"; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Copilot Dashboard access minimumGroupSize Viva insights settings API. Opened dashboard settings and privacy settings; no setting operation found.

claims.where: controls[3].ui and api; summary; Governance controls
claims.claim: No separate UI or API switch is documented for weekly and monthly trendlines.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Dashboard weekly monthly trendlines disable setting feature access control; "trendlines" "disable" "Copilot Dashboard". Opened dashboard, dashboard settings, VFAM and policy reference; found app-wide controls, no separate trendline control.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No meter or per-use charge is documented for viewing the dashboard or its trendlines at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Dashboard trendlines pricing billing meter per use charge; Viva Insights Copilot Dashboard licensing pricing billing. Opened dashboard license table and Microsoft Viva plans and pricing; no dashboard or trendline viewing meter found.

claims.claim: The dashboard settings documentation provides a control to turn off automatic dashboard access.
claims.quote: This feature access control allows AI Administrators to enable or disable the auto-enablement feature for the Viva Insights web app in their tenant.

claims.claim: Feature access policy changes take effect within 24 hours for the web app.
claims.quote: Changes to access policies take effect for the user within 24 hours, unless noted for a specific feature. Changes for Copilot in Viva Engage might take up to 48 hours.

claims.claim: People with dashboard access can delegate access to others.
claims.quote: If you have access to the dashboard, you can also delegate access to the dashboard to other people in your company.

claims.claim: The documentation does not resolve whether each weekly Copilot trendline point is separately tested against the minimum group size.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Dashboard" "minimum group size" "weekly" privacy data points. Opened dashboard, dashboard settings and privacy settings. Manager-settings search discusses weekly Outlook/Teams activity, not the treatment of individual weekly Copilot trendline points.
